_about: Country photos (UX phase 2d). Four per country, one per role: hero (the most iconic image, 16:9), feature (seat of government, or another representative subject where none is usable, 4:5 portrait beside the overview), backdrop (capital or major city, shown dimmed behind the charts), band (UNESCO site or signature landscape, 21:9 strip before the instruments). All from Wikimedia Commons under PD, CC0, CC BY or CC BY-SA; licence and author read from the Commons file page. International and regional organisations: the same four roles under "bodies" (images in site/img/bodies/<CODE>/); optional, a body without photos shows its member map. Fetched with scripts/fetch_photos.py.
